text: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge declined to comment on the Cockroach Janta Party's participation in an upcoming opposition rally. PTI reports that Kharge's office clarified he did not wish to comment on the question, following an initially erroneous report.

sources.title: Anti-SIR rally: Kharge declines to comment on CJP’s participation - ThePrint
sources.articleText:
Bengaluru, Oct 30 (PTI) Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge has refused to comment on whether CJP leaders will participate in the November 1 rally in Delhi planned by the opposition against SIR .
PTI had on Thursday erroneously reported that Kharge had replied in the negative taking note of his gesture. However, his office clarified he did not wish to comment on the question.
The Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) has extended support to the November 1 rally. The outfit, founded by Abhijeet Dipke, said it would support organisations fighting for free and fair elections and reiterated its demand for Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation.
